<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Create a vertical Chinese infographic. The title must be accurately displayed as:
“家庭咖啡冲煮指南”. The content should only contain the following four steps:
“1. 称取咖啡豆”
“2. 均匀研磨”
“3. 分段注水”
“4. 等待萃取完成”. Arrange these in four numbered modules from top to bottom, each containing a simple icon.

Creamy white background, dark brown text, with a small amount of orange for emphasis.

All text must be clearly legible; no other text, brands, logos, or watermarks may be added.
```
